## What changes are you trying to make?

<!-- The goal in a sentence or two, specific enough that a reviewer knows what to check. "Various updates" is too vague. -->

## Was there another approach you were thinking about?

<!-- Alternatives you considered and set aside, such as a different model specification, variable operationalization or data source, and why you set them aside. -->

## Were there any challenges? How did you overcome them?

<!-- Missing values in a key variable, a version conflict, an ambiguous codebook entry. Writing them down helps whoever picks up the work next. -->

## How were these changes tested?

<!-- A full pipeline run, a spot-check against known values, a unit test. Say what you ran and what you compared the output with. -->

## AI involvement

<!-- Tick whichever applies. -->

- [ ] Human-only
- [ ] AI-assisted (new code generated with AI tooling)
- [ ] AI-refactored (existing code restructured with AI tooling)

## Checklist

- [ ] These changes run as intended on my machine.
